rawContent: @SusannaRustin The v. brief, fashionable feminist moment (tee-shirts; Beyoncé; #MeToo) has gone & feminism once again holds its reputation for scolding/buzz killing. Meanwhile, queer culture is parades, rainbows and rebellion. Feminism is unglamorous, hard work, & immersed in class/race issues.

@SusannaRustin I should mention ‘the moment’ was very white (#metoo), capitalist (teen vogue), male-friendly (can’t scare the horses) and utterly ersatz. The new misogyny, however, is very real. A new, perhaps surprising, group of men and women have signed up to defend the patriarchy.
